states.description: Client provides no token or empty Authorization header
Token exists in memory sessionMap, now < session.ExpiresAt, user exists in UsersStore, and now < user.ExpiresAt
Session TTL has elapsed (now >= session.ExpiresAt). Lazily deleted on lookup
User account has expired (now >= user.ExpiresAt). Login rejected with 403; active sessions rejected with 401 and swept periodically
states.observable_body_login: 账号已到期，请联系管理员延时

states.description: Token does not exist in memory map (random token, malformed token, or post-restart token)

transitions.side_effects: Creates 64-char hex token, session.ExpiresAt = now + 24h, sessionMap[token] = session
Deletes token from sessionMap under sync.Mutex lock, returns 200 {"status": "success"}

transitions.trigger: now >= session.ExpiresAt evaluated during token lookup (main.lYKp_Iuf)
transitions.side_effects: Lazily deletes token from sessionMap under sync.Mutex lock, returns 401 Unauthorized

transitions.trigger: now >= user.ExpiresAt evaluated during token lookup or by 1-min sweeper
transitions.side_effects: Lookup fails with 401; sweeper revokes all user tokens and kicks connections
Memory sessionMap reinitializes empty, previously issued token no longer resolves
